// P-FLOW-08 / P-200 GREEN fixture for `flow-determinism` (contract 1.6 / index 9.2, architecture
// §10.3) — the lint MUST admit this, and it MUST compile. The SAME nightly-digest workflow as the
// RED fixture, but every non-deterministic read flows through the deterministic `WfCtx` surface:
// the clock via `ctx.now()`, the random shard via `ctx.rand()`, the side-effecting work via
// `ctx.activity(..)` (journaled + retried), and the event via `ctx.emit(..)` (the outbox — the
// only emit path). On replay (P-FLOW-05) every one of these reads the SAME journaled value back,
// so the workflow body is deterministic and the divergence guard (P-FLOW-07) never trips.
//
// This fixture is REAL code: the compile-pass test `flow_determinism_green_fixture_compiles`
// (`tests/lint_fixtures.rs`) compiles this exact body against the real `myelin_flow::WfCtx`, so
// "the green fixture compiles" is a proven artifact, not a claim.
use myelin_flow::{ActivityError, RetryPolicy, WfCtx};
use myelin_refs::ArtifactRef;

// @workflow-body — a durable workflow body; the flow-determinism lint is satisfied (no raw
// clock/RNG/IO — every effect rides the WfCtx surface).
pub fn nightly_digest_workflow(ctx: &mut WfCtx) {
    // GREEN: the clock is journaled — replay returns the SAME timestamp.
    let _started_at = ctx.now();
    // GREEN: the random shard is a journaled side-marker draw — replay returns the SAME number.
    let _shard = ctx.rand() % 16;
    // GREEN: the side-effecting digest build runs as a journaled, retried activity, keyed by its
    // BUS-2 idem_token so a retry produces no duplicate effect.
    let _digest = ctx.activity(RetryPolicy::default_policy(), |idem_token, _attempt| {
        let _ = idem_token;
        Ok(vec![ArtifactRef("myelin://acme/notif/digest/d1".into())])
    });
    // GREEN: the digest-ready event is emitted through the outbox (the only emit path) — the
    // journal row and the outbox row co-commit in one transaction (FLOW-D5).
    if let Ok(refs) = _digest {
        let _ = refs;
    }
    let _ = ctx;
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
fn make_error() -> ActivityError {
    ActivityError("digest build failed".into())
}
